common.restart_to_apply: Restart the game to apply the changes.
notify.restart_needed: Harmonia was disabled. Text translated so far stays until the game restarts.
restart.title: Harmonia
restart.message: Harmonia was loaded again in the same game session. It stays off until the game restarts, so the game text is never partly translated.
status.no_pack: No translation pack is active. Choose one on the Packs tab.
status.pack_failed: The selected pack could not be loaded: {0}
status.pack_not_usable: The pack is not installed or does not fit this game client.
status.engine_errors: running, {0} rows failed and were left untranslated
status.layout_mismatch: {0} sheets have a different layout in this game version and stay untranslated.
status.counts_hint: Counts grow as the game loads text. A string is translated only when the game text is exactly the one the translation was made for.
packs.hint: The selected pack is applied at the next game start.
packs.empty: No packs are installed. Import a .hpk file or add a feed on the Updates tab.
packs.requires_language: Made for a {0} client; this client is {1}.
packs.game_drift: Built for another game version than {0}: strings that changed stay untranslated.
trust.title: Confirm the publisher
trust.first_use: {0} is signed with key {1}. Harmonia will trust only this key for this pack from now on. Compare it with the key the publisher announced.
trust.key_changed: {0} is signed with key {1}, but this pack was trusted with key {2}. Install it only if the publisher announced the new key.
trust.unsigned: {0} is not signed. Anyone could have made it. Install it only if you built it yourself or trust its source.
trust.downgrade: This is release {0}, older than the installed release {1}.
updates.hint: Feeds tell Harmonia about new releases of a pack. Every download is checked against the pack itself and its trusted publisher key.
updates.trust_prompt: Publisher key: {0}. Check it against the one the publisher announced.
updates.error_unsigned: The release is not signed. Feeds can only install signed packs.
updates.error_key_changed: The release is signed by a different key than the trusted one. Import it manually if the publisher changed keys.
updates.notify_installed: {0}: update {1} installed, restart the game to apply it
settings.apply_unreviewed_hint: Some packs also contain drafts that were not reviewed yet. Turn this off to show only reviewed translations. Applies after a game restart.
diagnostics.no_sheets: No sheet of the pack was loaded yet.
